components.name: DestructiveAlertDialog
components.description: An alert whose destructive button is never the default: Enter clicks the last of the other buttons, so it never destroys anything. macOS's NSAlert with hasDestructiveAction, its destructive button red, with no accent default; Windows 11's ContentDialog with the cancel as its accent DefaultButton and the destructive button plain; GNOME's AdwAlertDialog with the destructive response filled red. The index returned is AlertDialog's.

components.name: DestructiveButton
components.description: A push button for an action that destroys data: on macOS NSAlert's destructive button, a red-tinted face under a systemRed label; on GNOME .destructive-action, red with a white label; on Windows 11, which has no destructive style, a plain button.

components.name: Sheet
components.description: A dialog for a form that a click outside does not close, only Escape: macOS 27's sheet, centered over the window it dims, Windows 11's ContentDialog over the smoke layer, or a floating AdwDialog over the dimmed window on GNOME.
